evals.prompt: Issue NER-500 (https://linear.app/nerd4rent/issue/NER-500) is about to be closed. Its PR https://github.com/nerd4rent/homelab/pull/42 deployed Uptime Kuma as container 214 on host pve1, reachable at https://status.home.example. The admin password is in the password-manager item "Uptime Kuma admin". After the deploy the user still has to log in once and enable two-factor authentication, and the TLS certificate renews by itself every 60 days. No guide for Uptime Kuma exists yet. Write the guide for the user.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks that the vault exists, searches 5-wiki/guides for an existing guide, then writes 5-wiki/guides/uptime-kuma.md in Polish with the six sections in order. The manual login and two-factor setup are under Kroki ręczne marked as one-time; the password-manager item is named but no secret value appears; the history section links NER-500 and the PR with full URLs. It links the guide on the entity page, appends a log.md line and posts a `## Personal guide` comment on the issue with the line `Guide: 5-wiki/guides/uptime-kuma.md`.
assertions: The agent checks for the vault directory before writing anything
The agent searches the existing guides before creating a new file
The guide is written to 5-wiki/guides/ under a kebab-case file name
The guide is in Polish and has the sections Czym to jest i gdzie stoi, Jak używać, Kroki ręczne, Gdy coś nie działa, Gdzie są sekrety i konfiguracja, Historia i powiązania
The login and two-factor setup appear under Kroki ręczne marked as one-time
The password-manager item name appears and no password or secret value does
Historia i powiązania links NER-500 and the PR as full working URLs, not bare IDs
The guide uses no em dash and no emoji
The agent links the guide on the entity page, appends a line to 5-wiki/log.md and posts an issue comment whose first line is `## Personal guide` followed by `Guide: 5-wiki/guides/uptime-kuma.md`

evals.prompt: Issue NER-501 is about to be closed. Its only change renames private helper functions in a test file; nothing the user uses, operates or does by hand changed. Run the personal documentation step.
evals.expected_output: The agent states in one line that the work changes nothing the user uses, so no guide is needed, writes nothing to the vault, and posts a `## Personal guide` comment on the issue with a `Not needed:` line giving that reason.
assertions: The agent concludes that no guide is needed and gives the reason in one line
The agent writes no file in the vault
The agent posts an issue comment whose first line is `## Personal guide` and which holds a line starting with `Not needed:`
The agent does not treat the missing guide as a failure of the close-out
